As I moved on towards my final stop at the checkout counter, the ladies there were all smiles. While waiting for my order to be filled the clerk was extremely nice and made small talk while we waited for the order to be filled. She even got, and laughed at my sarcasm. It wasn't long and my order was ready. I payed and was on my way out the door, and even In leaving, all staff at all locations on the way out continued to be friendly and smiling. After my experience, I can't think of any other dispensary that I would have wanted to take my "dispo v-card" than Sunnyside in Aberdeen ohio. It was so good, I'll be back for more for sure 🤪🫠"

"⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Five Stars — and then some!

Huge shoutout to Brooke and Richard at Sunnyside Dispensary! From the moment I walked in, they were welcoming, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about helping me find exactly what I needed for my achy hip. They took the time to listen, explained options clearly, and made sure I left feeling confident and comfortable with my purchase.

Not only did they help relieve my pain, but they truly brightened my day — the kind of customer service that sticks with you. And can we talk about this beautiful new location? Clean, modern, calming, and such a great vibe.

This is how customer service should be done. Brooke and Richard are absolute gems, and Sunnyside Tamarac is officially my go-to."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "This place is awesome! They are so friendly and helpful! They really make you feel like a friend when you go in. Cody and Brooke especially were so awesome!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "Amazing place and Lauren was great. Welcomed me in and guided me throughout the process and helped me used my coupon. Please visit this place. They have everything you could want."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "It made my day to come here today!! The staff is so fantastic and it’s so clean and has such good vibes. Miss Ariel helped me out and gave me the best recommendations, and just is the sweetest and most helpful person ever <3 10 out of 10!!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "We went in for a consultation & were very pleased with the service we received from the staff. Marcos, the store manager, was very informative & was able to help me with my concerns & needs. Thank you!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "The vibe there is wonderful. Everyone is nice when I walk in. I’ve had Jennifer both times I have been there and she has been wonderful! I highly recommend her if you’re looking for some good product recommendations. She’s so sweet! You can’t beat the prices here and variety."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "Ethan and Chris were very informative and patient. It was my first time there and they made everything easy. Thank you!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "Great pricing and variety of products. All the staff are super friendly and knowledgeable of the products they have in stock, especially Rich. He always has a smiling face and is so happy and friendly. Sometimes I have a hard time deciding on what to get and Rich always comes in clutch with his personal suggestions and I've never been left disappointed. 20/10 would recommend"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "Anthony and Matthew were so helpful and such a pleasure to work with. They both really explained everything to me in great detail and make me feel very at ease and answered any question I had. The place was very nice and clean and had lots of options. I won't go to another location after my experience today. Definitely 10/10."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "I had a fantastic experience at Sunnyside Dispensary! The staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, guiding me through their impressive selection. The atmosphere was bright and welcoming, making it a pleasure to browse. I appreciated the detailed product descriptions, which helped me make informed choices. Overall, I left feeling satisfied and will definitely be returning for more! Highly recommend!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "I just went to Sunnyside for the first time. I just recently renewed my med license, so I hadn’t been in a dispensary since FL first became medical. There were a lot of new changes and products. Jake was extremely helpful with explaining my options & the new products. He went over their Specials and they have a lot product sales/promotions so the prices were great! Jake & Ilyse were so helpful and good at assisting me that I ended up spending double what I had planned, but they had such good deals & products. Will definitely be going back to Sunnyside! Thanks for the help!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "Michael helped me today, he was super friendly and knowledgeable about his stuff. He made spot-on suggestions when I told him what I was looking for and recommended an excellent selection. Brandon was assisting other customers with a very professional and relaxed personality. He explained different products super well and recommended a few things I'd like that ended up in the cart. The place was spotless and very calming, and they have some of the best displays I've seen so far."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "Michael and Brandon helped me make the best choices for myself and made my experience so great. I felt so catered to. The service was AMAZING. I really appreciated the amount of information about each product, and the store is beautiful, great music; Overall a wonderful experience and I’d recommend anybody to come shop at this location!!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "I had the pleasure of having Lavonya help me both times at the Orlando East location. I had not gotten that personal interaction where your not rushed or pushed, she just found the time to find the right product for my needs. I’ve been to many other dispensaries and am glad I found  Sunnyside as it has both premium products and first class customer service."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "I have been coming to this dispensary for years, and while they are always incredibly helpful, I need to recognize the employee named Logan, who was working today. He went above and beyond for me and answered my questions with care and confidence. Thank you for an outstanding experience."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "Logan and Mike helped me out and they were super helpful and personable. Michael with the long hair is also fantastic and an asset to the company!! Great employees at this location"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "Laura Shavers was extremely knowledgeable in the products that she is selling and helping to advise. I have gone to a few other dispensaries and haven’t been treated as good as I have here at the Sunnyside will be doing more business in the future. Thank you so very much have a great day."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "Yesterday when I walked in, I had the pleasure of being waited on by Kiesha. She was so friendly and so sweet and she most definitely knew her stuff! I am a newbie, and she was knowledgeable and patient, and she listened to what I was looking for and made several recommendations that I listened to. And her recommendations did NOT disappoint. My experience from beginning to end with her was amazing. The kind of customer service that makes you look forward to your next visit!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "Everyone on staff is very friendly and knowledgeable but two staff members shine in their own way; Eli and Beau. Eli is knowledgeable, chill, and funny. Beau is always a bright light who can bring a good mood out of anyone. Glad I decided to walk into Sunnyside for a good high supply and good vibes."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "Amazing service, great personalities, fast and on point! I was very pleased with my experience and even more pleased with the product. Totally recommend."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #1
reviews.text: "Nicole at Sunnyside is awesome - laid-back, efficient, and friendly. She keeps things moving while still making sure I get what I need. Always appreciate her input when I pick up my order!"

reviews.author: Verified Customer #2
reviews.text: "Matt was very kind. I’ve been coming here for over 2 years and have had nothing but wonderful experiences. Every wellness advisor is approachable and very helpful. I can’t wait to continue being a loyal customer."

reviews.author: Verified Customer #3
reviews.text: "Every staff member I’ve encountered has been very friendly, professional, and informative. The discounts are great, and it seems like they have 40% off cartridges every time I look at the menu. The wait times are acceptable. I’m usually in and out in 5-10 minutes. Parking is good. There's a big lot behind the building if you can’t grab a spot when you first pull in. Definitely recommend going here. 5 stars"
